annotations.title: Aggregate OSM Features into H3 Hexagons

description: Executes an Overpass query and bins the results into H3 hexagons at a specified resolution to analyze spatial density. Plots the top density hotspots on the shareable verification map.

bbox.description: The bounding box geometry to parse.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'Seattle').

radius_meters.description: Optional search radius in metres around the location/bbox center.

resolution.description: The H3 resolution level (0-15) for binning. Default is 8.

timeout_seconds.description: Overpass server query timeout in seconds. Default is 25.

use_area_boundary.description: If true (default), uses exact OSM boundary polygon for named locations when available.

name: aggregate_overpass_h3
